definition: a platform where people stand to be seen
description: A theatre stage under a single beam of spotlight, with the dark silhouetted heads of the audience along the bottom of the frame. Something huge stands on the sand-covered stage floor under a turquoise silk sheet. A man in a white suit walks on from the side, takes the corner of the silk and pulls; the sheet lifts and floats away, and on the stage stands a life-size elephant made entirely of red, orange and white flowers. He steps back and the whole flower skin bursts apart into a curtain of falling petals that pours down over the stage. When the petals clear, a real elephant is standing there in the spotlight with a ring of red flowers on its head, lifting its trunk, and the stage floor is carpeted with petals while the audience films it.
